properties.description: Linked service for Teradata EDW. Migrated from DataStage parameters: $Teradata_EDW_DSN, $Teradata_EDW_User_Grupo1, $Teradata_EDW_PWD_Grupo1. Requires Self-Hosted Integration Runtime (SHIR) with Teradata ODBC driver installed, OR Azure IR with Teradata Connector. All credentials must be stored in Azure Key Vault.
annotations: manual_action: Set Teradata-EDW-ConnectionString secret in Key Vault as: SERVER=<tdp_id>;
manual_action: Set Teradata-EDW-User-Grupo1 secret in Key Vault
manual_action: Set Teradata-EDW-PWD-Grupo1 secret in Key Vault
manual_action: Install Teradata ODBC/JDBC driver on SHIR node
